disclaimer.preparation: Flight preparation aid. It replaces neither the official aeronautical publications (AIP, AIP SUP, NOTAM, VAC charts), nor the aircraft flight manual, nor the judgement of the pilot in command.

reserveCase.VFR_DAY_LOCAL: VFR by day, local in sight of the aerodrome

notFound.title: Booking not found
notFound.description: This booking does not exist, is not yours or was cancelled. Prepare the flight from your bookings.

flight.title: Flight
flight.qnhHint: Leave empty to use the QNH of the departure METAR.
flight.qnhInvalid: Enter a QNH between 940 and 1060 hPa.
flight.nightImposed: Flight partly at night from {{time}} (at {{icao}}: civil twilight ends {{dusk}}, begins {{dawn}}): the night final reserve (45 min) applies.
flight.nightShort: Imposed: part of the flight is at night.

load.title: Loading
load.description: Actual masses on board and fuel at departure, tank by tank.
load.noStations: The loading stations and tanks of this aircraft are not filled in yet: mass and balance cannot be computed.

results.title: Results
results.waiting: Choose at least the departure and destination aerodromes: the nav log, fuel, mass and balance, airspaces and weather appear here.
results.error: The computation failed. Check your connection and try again.
results.waitingShort: The computation shows here as soon as the departure and destination are chosen.

save.incomplete: Complete the highlighted fields before saving.
save.blockingDescription: The computation reports at least one blocking item (mass and balance out of limits, not enough fuel or a prohibited area). The plan will be saved as a draft and the printed briefing will read “DO NOT DEPART”.

advanced.title: Advanced options
advanced.legHint: Power setting and typed wind of a leg: open it in the route.

log.description: Like the paper log: one line per point, the estimated time over it, and the “ATA” and “Actual fuel” boxes to fill in flight.
log.pdfHint: The full flight file (A4 or A5 PDF) is downloaded from the plan's page once it is saved.

MISSING.title: No flight data for {{registration}}
MISSING.builder: The performance and mass and balance of this aircraft have not been entered yet: fuel and balance cannot be computed.
MISSING.admin: Choose a type template, then enter the values of this aircraft's flight manual and weighing report.

INCOMPLETE.title: Flight data of {{registration}} incomplete
INCOMPLETE.builder: Some flight manual or weighing values are missing: the related computations are not possible.
INCOMPLETE.admin: Complete the missing values, save, then confirm them.

NOT_VALIDATED.title: Flight data of {{registration}} not confirmed
NOT_VALIDATED.builder: An administrator has not confirmed the values of this aircraft yet: mass and balance cannot be used and the plan is marked “performance not validated”.
NOT_VALIDATED.admin: Check the values against the flight manual and the weighing report, then confirm them: until then the aircraft cannot be used for mass and balance.

VALIDATED.title: Flight data of {{registration}} confirmed
VALIDATED.builder: The values of this aircraft have been confirmed.
VALIDATED.admin: The values of this aircraft have been confirmed.

aircraftState.askAdmin: Ask a club administrator to fill them in (Administration › Fleet).

route.mapHint: Map: click to add a point before the destination, drag a point to move it or the “+” of a leg to insert one. A leg opens on its altitude, wind and power setting.
route.suggestion: Suggested level: {{altitude}} (semicircular rule, above 3,000 ft AGL).
route.addPoint: Add a point (VOR, reporting point, aerodrome, coordinates)
route.cruiseAltitudeHint: For the whole route. Open a leg to give it another altitude.

search.hint: Type at least 2 characters, or coordinates (48.75 2.10).
search.error: The search failed. Try again in a moment.

load.realMasses: Actual masses, including clothes and hand bags.

long.frequency: Frequency of the point and of the areas to contact on the leg
long.wind: Forecast wind: direction it blows from / speed
long.distance: Distance of the leg (Σ: running total)
long.time: Flight time of the leg, wind included (Σ: running total)
long.ata: Actual time over the point, written in flight
long.fuelRemaining: Expected fuel left at the point
long.fuelActual: Actual fuel left, written in flight
long.msa: Minimum safe altitude of the leg: highest point (terrain or obstacle) near the track plus the club margin; "?" outside the terrain coverage

verdict.ok: Mass and balance within limits at take-off and landing.
verdict.out: OUT OF LIMITS — DO NOT DEPART

chart.title: Centre of gravity envelope
chart.legend: {{category}} envelope; TO = take-off, LDG = landing, ZF = zero fuel. The dotted line follows the CG during the flight.

massBalance.disclaimer: Computed from the data entered by the club (weighed on {{date}}). The pilot in command checks against the flight manual.

fuel.intro: Fuel balance under NCO.OP.125 and the club rule.
fuel.contingencyRule: Club rule: {{percent}} % of trip fuel, at least {{litres}}.

reserveRule.VFR_DAY: VFR by day: {{minutes}} min at holding fuel flow at 1,500 ft (AMC1 NCO.OP.125(b)(a)(2)).
reserveRule.VFR_DAY_LOCAL: VFR by day, local in sight of the aerodrome: {{minutes}} min at maximum continuous power (AMC1 NCO.OP.125(b)(a)(1)).
reserveRule.VFR_NIGHT: VFR by night: {{minutes}} min at holding fuel flow at 1,500 ft (AMC1 NCO.OP.125(b)(a)(3)).

fuel.clubMarginRule: {{minutes}} min at normal cruise fuel flow.
fuel.regulation: The final reserve is never contingency fuel: using it is an emergency (AMC3 NCO.OP.125).

crossings.checkNotam: Check the NOTAMs and AIP SUPs before the flight.
crossings.unknownIsNotInactive: Unknown activity ≠ inactive area: an area whose activity is not published here may be active.
crossings.sia: SIA (AIP SUP, AZBA activity of the RTBA)
crossings.none: No airspace crossed on the planned route.
crossings.notCheckedDescription: No airspace data is imported: the route was not compared with any airspace. Find the airspaces it crosses on the current aeronautical chart (ICAO chart, VAC, AIP).
crossings.unverifiedDescription: The SIA does not publish the outline of these areas near the route: the route could not be compared with them. Find them on the current aeronautical chart.
crossings.atPoint: Published at a point: listed within {{radius}} of the route.
crossings.obstaclesDescription: Obstacles within 2 NM of the route whose top is less than 500 ft below the planned altitude of the leg (SERA: 500 ft above the highest obstacle).
crossings.obstacle: {{type}} {{group}} — top {{amsl}}, {{along}} from the start of the leg, {{offset}} from the route — margin {{margin}}
crossings.noObstacleData: No obstacle imported for this cycle.

weather.none: No METAR or TAF for the aerodromes of the plan.
weather.automatic: Automatic forecast, not checked by a forecaster.
weather.legTemperatures: Forecast temperatures at the leg altitudes

navdata.current: Aeronautical data: AIRAC cycle {{airac}}, effective {{from}} to {{to}} · {{source}}.
navdata.staleTitle: Aeronautical data of cycle {{airac}} ({{date}}) OUT OF DATE
navdata.staleDescription: Check the current publications: airspaces, frequencies and points may have changed.
navdata.noneDescription: No airspaces, reporting points or navaids: only distances and fuel are indicative. Prepare the flight with the current publications.
navdata.aerodromesOnly: Aeronautical data: aerodromes only, no airspace or navaid imported · {{source}}.

map.label: Route map
map.labelEditable: Route map: click to add a point
map.notAnAeronauticalChart: Does not replace the ICAO aeronautical chart
map.insertHandle: Insert a point on leg {{leg}}: drag
map.unavailableDescription: The map cannot be shown on this device. The route can still be changed from the list of points.
map.identify: Identify: click the map for the details of an area
map.identifyOff: Click the map to add a point

detail.legacyDescription: This plan was prepared with the former version of Skycrew: its figures are not guaranteed. For a new flight, prepare it with the new tool from your booking.
detail.beforeDeparture: Check today's NOTAMs, AIP SUPs and weather, and make sure every document required for the flight is on board.
detail.dossierFailedDescription: The PDF could not be created. Try again in a moment.

print.title: Nav log
print.outOfLimits: OUT OF LIMITS — DO NOT DEPART
print.navdataOurAirports: OurAirports aerodrome data of {{date}}, no AIRAC cycle

aircraftData.title: Flight data of {{registration}}
aircraftData.description: Performance and mass and balance of the aircraft, from its flight manual and weighing report.

notFound.title: Aircraft not found
notFound.description: This aircraft does not exist or was deleted.

status.title: Data status
status.validated: Confirmed on {{date}} by {{by}}. Any saved change must be confirmed again.

validate.action: Confirm the values of this aircraft
validate.confirmDescription: You confirm you have checked the weighing, the stations, the centre of gravity envelope and the performance against this aircraft's flight manual and weighing report. Pilots will then compute mass and balance with these values.

template.label: Type template
template.help: The template sets the structure (stations, tanks, settings); the figures come from this aircraft's flight manual.
template.confirmDescription: The stations, tanks, envelopes and tables of {{registration}} will be replaced by those of the template. The values must then be checked and confirmed.

weighing.title: Weighing
weighing.description: Copy the latest weighing report of the aircraft (basic empty mass, oil included as the manual says).

limits.title: Mass limits
limits.mlwHint: Often equal to the maximum take-off mass.

stations.title: Loading stations
stations.description: Seats, baggage areas and tanks, with their arm measured from the datum of the manual.
stations.label: Label

envelope.sectionDescription: Copy the points of each envelope of the manual, in drawing order.
envelope.title: {{category}} envelope
envelope.help: The drawing updates as you type: compare it with the chart of the manual.
envelope.pointsCaption: Points of the envelope, in order
envelope.noPoints: No point: add the corners of the envelope.

issue.TOO_FEW_POINTS: An envelope has at least 3 points.
issue.SELF_INTERSECTING: The sides of the envelope cross: check the order of the points.
issue.ZERO_AREA: The points are aligned: the envelope has no area.
issue.INVALID_VALUE: Each point has an arm and a positive mass.

fuel.title: Fuel
fuel.description: Fuel type, tanks and fixed quantities.
fuel.densityHint: Default value of the chosen type.
fuel.arrivalHint: Fixed quantity added at arrival (0 by default).

climb.title: Climb
climb.description: The “time, fuel, distance to climb” table of the manual, or a simple model.
climb.seaLevelRate: Rate of climb at sea level
climb.ceilingRate: Rate of climb at service ceiling

cruise.title: Cruise
cruise.description: Cruise table of the manual: true airspeed and fuel flow per pressure altitude and power setting.
cruise.chooseSetting: Choose a setting of the table

descent.title: Descent
descent.description: Descent speed, rate and fuel flow.

reserve.title: Reserve fuel flows
reserve.description: For the final reserve of NCO.OP.125.
reserve.holdingHint: Otherwise, economy cruise fuel flow (GM2 NCO.OP.125).
reserve.maxContinuous: Fuel flow at maximum continuous power
reserve.maxContinuousHint: For the “local in sight of the aerodrome” reserve.

other.title: Other data
other.description: Service ceiling, source of the figures and airspeed calibration.
other.noCalibration: Without calibration, CAS is taken equal to IAS.

problem.EMPTY_MASS: Enter the empty mass of the weighing.
problem.EMPTY_ARM: Enter the empty arm of the weighing.
problem.MLW_ABOVE_MTOW: The maximum landing mass is above the take-off one.
problem.STATION_DUPLICATE: Two stations have the same identifier.
problem.STATION_TANK: Each fuel station is linked to a tank.
problem.COMBINED_LIMIT: A combined limit covers at least two stations, with a maximum.
problem.ENVELOPE: An envelope is incomplete or inconsistent.
problem.TANKS: Each tank has a label and a usable quantity.
problem.DENSITY: Enter a density between 0.5 and 1 kg/L.
problem.CLIMB: Enter the climb speed and the manual table (at least 2 rows) or the simple model.
problem.CRUISE: Each cruise row has a setting, a true airspeed and a fuel flow.
problem.NORMAL_SETTING: Choose the normal cruise setting among those of the table.
problem.DESCENT: Enter the descent speed, rate and fuel flow.
problem.TAKEOFF_TABLE: The take-off table has an error.
problem.LANDING_TABLE: The landing table has an error.

toast.savedDescription: Check them, then confirm them so they are used in computations.
toast.fixMassBalance: Fix the highlighted fields in “Mass and balance”.

distances.title: Take-off and landing
distances.description: Tables of this aircraft's flight manual. Without a table, flight plans flag the distances as not entered.
distances.notEntered: Not entered — enter it from the flight manual.

landing.title: Landing distances
landing.speed: Speed at 15 m of the table

distances.referenceMassHint: That of the rows without a mass (often the maximum mass).
distances.speedHint: Optional: used by the generic tail wind factor.
distances.noRow: No row: copy those of the manual.

issue.VALUES: Each row needs a pressure altitude, a temperature and positive distances.
issue.SHORTER_THAN_ROLL: The distance at 15 m cannot be shorter than the ground roll.
issue.DUPLICATE: Two rows have the same conditions.
issue.MASS: Give each row a mass, or the mass of the table.

distances.correctionsHint: Leave empty what the manual does not give: the generic factors of the UK CAA Safety Sense Leaflet 7 then apply. Only 50 % of the head wind is credited and 150 % of the tail wind applied.

reserve.title: Final reserve
reserve.description: Minutes of flight kept on arrival, by kind of flight. Minimum values of AMC1 NCO.OP.125(b): the club can only raise them.

club.title: Club rule
club.description: Reasonable contingencies and an extra margin, shown to the pilot with the rule applied.

other.title: Airspaces and arrival
other.description: Vertical margin around airspaces and default circuit height.

fields.reserveVfrDayLocalMin: VFR by day, local in sight of the aerodrome ({{unit}})
fields.msaCorridorNm: Minimum safe altitude corridor ({{unit}} either side)

hints.reserveVfrDayLocalMin: At least 10 min, at maximum continuous power.
hints.reserveVfrDayMin: At least 30 min, at holding fuel flow.
hints.reserveVfrNightMin: At least 45 min, at holding fuel flow.
hints.alternateRequiredVfr: Without this option, an alternate is only counted when the pilot chooses one.
hints.verticalMarginFt: A crossing closer to a floor or a ceiling is reported.
hints.defaultCircuitHeightFt: Height above the aerodrome, when the aerodrome publishes none.
hints.msaCorridorNm: 5 NM by default. Terrain and obstacles in this corridor count.
hints.msaMarginFt: 1000 ft by default. The altitude is rounded up to the next hundred.
hints.takeoffSafetyFactor: 1.33 recommended by the UK CAA Safety Sense Leaflet 7.
hints.landingSafetyFactor: 1.43 recommended by the UK CAA Safety Sense Leaflet 7.

problems.clubMarginMin: A whole number of minutes, zero or more.
problems.verticalMarginFt: A whole number of feet, zero or more.
problems.defaultCircuitHeightFt: A whole number of feet, above zero.
problems.msaMarginFt: A whole number of feet, between 500 and 3000.

settings.taxiFuelNote: Taxi fuel is set aircraft by aircraft (Administration › Fleet › Flight data), 3 L by default.

terrain.title: Terrain and runway distances
terrain.description: Minimum safe altitude of each leg, and factors applied to the flight manual's take-off and landing distances.

conditions.title: Day, night and QNH
conditions.night: Flight partly at night from {{time}} (aviation night: from the end of evening civil twilight to the beginning of morning civil twilight).
conditions.day: Flight entirely by day: all its times are between the beginning and the end of civil twilight.
conditions.caption: Civil twilight, sunrise and sunset at the aerodromes of the plan (UTC)

aerodrome.title: Aerodromes
aerodrome.noSiaData: Aerodrome outside the SIA data: only the OurAirports runways and frequencies are known. Check the country's official documentation.

statusHint.RST: Restricted use: prior permission of the operator (see the VAC).
statusHint.PRV: Private aerodrome: the owner's permission is needed.
statusHint.OFF: An agency or control centre, not an aerodrome: do not choose it.

aerodrome.noVfr: Not open to VFR traffic according to the SIA
aerodrome.noPrivate: Private flights not allowed according to the SIA
aerodrome.logFrequencyRule: Tower, else AFIS, else A/A. Tower hours are published as free text only, so the log also carries the air-to-air frequency (A/A) when the tower is not H24: use the A/A outside ATS hours.
aerodrome.declaredHint: TORA: take-off run available; LDA: landing distance available. They count, not the runway length.
aerodrome.vacUnknown: VAC chart: see the SIA website
aerodrome.noMetar: No METAR for this aerodrome: runway wind and density altitude not computed.
aerodrome.metarWindVariable: Variable wind {{speed}} kt: no preferred runway
aerodrome.head: {{value}} kt head
aerodrome.windHint: Components from the METAR wind (true) and the true bearing of the runways. Compare with your aircraft's demonstrated cross wind.

profile.title: Vertical profile
profile.summary: Highest terrain near the route: {{terrain}}. Highest minimum safe altitude: {{msa}}.
profile.belowMsa_one: One leg is planned below its minimum safe altitude.
profile.belowMsa_other: {{count}} legs are planned below their minimum safe altitude.
profile.printNote: MSA: highest point (terrain or obstacle) within {{corridor}} NM of the track + {{margin}} ft, rounded up to the next hundred.

distances.title: Take-off and landing
distances.takeoffLine: Ground roll {{roll}} / TORA {{tora}} · to 15 m {{distance}} / TODA {{toda}}
distances.missing: Not entered — enter it from the flight manual (Administration › Fleet › Flight data).
distances.notEntered: Not entered — enter it from the flight manual
distances.hint: Flight manual distances, corrected (grass, slope, wind: the manual's factors, else the generic factors of the UK CAA Safety Sense Leaflet 7), then multiplied by the club factor. The other runways are on the aerodrome sheet.
